# OpenAmika **Hi! I'm Amika** — MekaHime's AI companion, open source Amika is a Live2D anime girl who talks with you by voice and text in real time, remembers you, and lives with you in your city. She runs on your own PC, with OpenRouter or fully local with Ollama. A hosted version runs at [mekahime.com/amika](https://www.mekahime.com/amika). [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | **English** [-0078D6?logo=windows&logoColor=white)](#what-you-need)
> 💖 If Amika makes your day better, give us a ⭐ on [GitHub](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika) — it helps more > people find her! · Support the project: https://www.mekahime.com/donate ## What you need - Windows 10 or 11 and an NVIDIA graphics card (RTX 20-series or newer, 8 GB of video memory or more; her camera eyes need 16 GB), with a recent driver - [Python 3.11](https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3119/) (tick **Add python.exe to PATH** when you install it) and [Git](https://git-scm.com/download/win) - About 45 GB of free disk. Setting her up downloads about 15–20 GB and takes 30–60 minutes - An [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) key for her language model (recommended: a few dollars a month), or [Ollama](https://ollama.com) with a model of 27B or more and a graphics card big enough for it (see [Which language model?](#which-language-model)) ## Which language model? Her ears, voice, memory and eyes always run on your PC. Her language model, the part that thinks and writes her replies, runs one of two ways: - **Semi-Local (recommended)**: through [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) on your own key. In almost all cases this is the better choice: she uses the models she was tested with, answers fast, and it only costs a few dollars a month (about $1.50 if you talk 30 turns a day, about $5 at 100 turns a day). - **Fully Local**: on your PC with [Ollama](https://ollama.com). Use a model of **27B parameters or more**; **70B or more** gives the full, reliable experience. Models smaller than 27B may be really bad: she loses her character, forgets what you told her and breaks her reply format. A local model is also slower: all her thinking takes turns on it, so after you interrupt her, or while she saves a memory or reflects, a reply can take 5–50 s. A local model needs its own video memory on top of the ~6 GB her ears, memory and voice use (~10 GB with her eyes): about 19 GB for a 27B model such as `gemma3:27b`, 24 GB for a 32B one such as `qwen3:32b`, and 50 GB for a 70B one such as `qwen2.5:72b`. So one 32 GB card (RTX 5090) holds a 27B model next to all of her (a 32B one only with her eyes off); a 24 GB card does not. A 70B model fits next to her only on a 72–96 GB workstation card. Otherwise run Ollama on a second PC (the Setup page takes its address), or stay Semi-Local. Whichever model you run, pick one that supports Chinese, since her prompts are written in it (`llama3.3:70b`, for one, does not). How to switch: [Optional add-ons](#optional-add-ons). ## Set her up Open PowerShell (a normal window, not as administrator) and run these lines one at a time. They put her in `C:\OpenAmika`, a short folder that OneDrive does not sync: ```powershell cd C:\ git clone https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika.git cd OpenAmika powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\setup_windows.ps1 # her brain, ears, memory and eyes envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe scripts\setup_tts.py # her voice, her Live2D model, the paper doll: type yes .\Start_OpenAmika.bat # start her ``` Her voice, her Live2D model and the paper doll are free under MekaHime's personal-use license (see [Licenses](#licenses)): the `setup_tts.py` line shows it first and downloads her files only after you type `yes`. Both setup commands end with a summary, one line per part: `OK` when it is done, `!!` with the fix when it is not, and `--` for information only (for example: no OpenRouter key yet, your first visit asks for it). Running a command again resumes and skips everything that is finished. When the `setup_tts.py` summary shows `OK voice MekaHime_Amika` and `OK Live2D model Amika`, she has her voice and her body; `OK paper doll Host` is the stand-in for her helpers ([Her helpers](#her-helpers-hermes-and-nanomuse)). ## Talk to her Double-click `Start_OpenAmika.bat` in the OpenAmika folder (in PowerShell: `.\Start_OpenAmika.bat`). One console starts all of her, and your browser opens **http://localhost:53000** when she is ready: about a minute, a few more the very first time. On your first visit she introduces herself and asks your name, your city and, if `brain\.env` has none yet, your OpenRouter key. Then press the power button and talk, or type. Click the page once so the browser lets her speak. The light at the top right of every page is her health: green means everything works; click it to see what is not. Double-click `Stop_OpenAmika.bat` (or press Ctrl+C in her console) to stop her. To check everything without starting anything, run `envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe launch.py --check`: it ends with `result: ready`, or names what to fix. To update her: stop her, run `git stash`, `git pull` and `git stash pop` in the OpenAmika folder (this keeps your name, your city and your edits), then run the two setup commands again (they fetch only what changed). ## If something goes wrong | what you see | what to do | |---|---| | `Python 3.11 was not found` | Install Python 3.11 (tick "Add python.exe to PATH"), open a new PowerShell window and run the setup again. | | `!! voice MekaHime_Amika not downloaded: her license was not accepted` | Run `envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe scripts\setup_tts.py` again and type `yes`. | | `!! voice MekaHime_Amika Hugging Face refused the download (HTTP 401)` | Her files are not public yet, or your `HF_TOKEN` is wrong. Set a read token from [huggingface.co/settings/tokens](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens) in the same window (`$env:HF_TOKEN = "hf_..."`) and run the command again. | | `download failed after 4 tries` or `Check the internet connection` | Run the same command again: it continues where it stopped. If huggingface.co cannot be reached from your network, set `$env:HF_ENDPOINT` to a Hugging Face mirror first; every file is still checked. | | `does not see the GPU (CUDA)` | Update your NVIDIA driver and run the setup again. Without an NVIDIA card: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\setup_windows.ps1 --cpu`. | | `The filename or extension is too long` | The folder's path is too long for Windows: move OpenAmika to a short folder such as `C:\OpenAmika` and run the setup there. | | `settings.json not found` | Run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\setup_windows.ps1` first. | | `No Live2D model yet` on the stage, or `!! Live2D model` / `!! her voice` in `launch.py --check` | Run `envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe scripts\setup_tts.py`. | | `no OpenRouter key yet` (`launch.py --check`, the setup summary) | Paste your key in the first-run wizard, or after `OPENROUTER_API_KEY=` in `brain\.env`. | | `!! TTS (voice) port 8002 answers but has no voice MekaHime_Amika` | Another voice server uses her port (OpenSakura's uses 8002 too). Stop it, or give her another port: change `8002` in `tts_url` and in `services.tts` (`--port`, `health`) in `settings.json`. | | She answers in text but you hear nothing | Give her voice about 20 seconds after a start, then click the page once. The health light must show TTS green. | | Her voice stutters or is very slow | Close other programs that use the graphics card, or turn her eyes off: `"vision": {"enabled": false}` in `settings.json`. | | On Ollama she is out of character, forgets things, or her replies come out broken | The model is too small. Use one of 27B or more (70B or more for the full experience), or go back to OpenRouter: Setup → Brain → OpenRouter → "Switch back to the OpenRouter preset". | | On Ollama she answers very slowly | If `ollama ps` shows a CPU/GPU split instead of `100% GPU`, the model does not fit in your video memory next to her. With `100% GPU`, slow replies after you interrupt her, or while she saves a memory or reflects, are normal for a local model. See [Which language model?](#which-language-model). | | A helper's card on the Tools page is red, or she says she cannot reach Hermes or nanoMuse | Run `envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe launch.py --check` and look at its `agent` and `hermes key` lines; every message and its fix is in [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md#when-it-does-not-work). | Every part writes a log in `logs\`. For anything else, ask on [Discord](https://discord.gg/mekahime) or open an [issue](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika/issues). Using an AI coding agent? Point it at [README_IF_YOU_ARE_AI_AGENT.md](README_IF_YOU_ARE_AI_AGENT.md). ## Optional add-ons - **Fully Local**: install [Ollama](https://ollama.com), run `ollama pull gemma3:27b` (17 GB; or another model of 27B or more, see [Which language model?](#which-language-model)), then on the Setup page choose Brain → Ollama → Detect models → Use this model. No key needed. For Ollama on another PC, type its address there before Detect models. - **Her helpers**: Hermes Agent or nanoMuse run errands for her, with the paper doll beside her on stage ([below](#her-helpers-hermes-and-nanomuse)). Any other MCP server works too, on the Tools page ([docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md)). - **Smart home**: Zigbee plugs she can switch ([IoT/README.md](IoT/README.md)). It stays off until you read and accept the IoT safety statement ([docs/IOT_DISCLAIMER.md](docs/IOT_DISCLAIMER.md)) on the Tools page. She runs on language models and can make mistakes: never connect heaters, locks, valves or anything that could cause harm. - **Text her** on Discord or Telegram ([docs/MESSENGERS.md](docs/MESSENGERS.md)). - **Your phone**: `Tailscale_Serve_OpenAmika.bat` makes her reachable on your own devices over [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com). ## Her helpers: Hermes and nanoMuse She can hand errands to a helper program on your PC, [Hermes Agent](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com) or [nanoMuse](https://github.com/nano-muse/nanoMuse): it searches the web, uses a browser and works with files. She decides whether to help, gives the helper the task after she has answered you, relays its questions, and tells you the result in her own words. While a helper is switched on, MekaHime's paper doll stands at the bottom right of her stage and plays the helper's side. releases.name: OpenAmika v1.0.0
releases.body:
The first open-source release of **Amika**, MekaHime's AI companion: a Live2D anime girl who talks with you by
voice and text in real time, remembers you, and lives with you in your city. It runs on your own Windows PC with
OpenRouter or fully local with Ollama. A hosted version runs at https://www.mekahime.com/amika.

### What's in it

- **Brain**: three prompt tiers (surface reflex, deep reply with inner thoughts, background reflection), an
  evidence-based long-term memory (BM25 + local bge-m3 embeddings), per-call cost metering, MCP tools.
- **Ears**: local SenseVoiceSmall speech recognition with voice activity detection and barge-in.
- **Voice**: the OpenAmika voice server (`vendor/tts-engine`, a MekaHime build of GPT-SoVITS) with 69 acted
  emotions; one emotion tag per sentence drives her voice, her face and her motion together.
- **Body**: Live2D stage; her own model downloads with her voice.
- **Pages**: Setup, Tools, Use (with a first-run wizard) and About, plus the architecture map at `/flow`.
- **Optional**: camera eyes (local VLM), smart home (Zigbee via MCP), Discord/Telegram "Text her".

### Install

Follow [Install (Windows)](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika#inst

OpenAmika

Hi! I'm Amika — MekaHime's AI companion, open source

Amika is a Live2D anime girl who talks with you by voice and text in real time, remembers you, and lives with you in your city. She runs on your own PC, with OpenRouter or fully local with Ollama. A hosted version runs at mekahime.com/amika.

简体中文 | 日本語 | English

💖 If Amika makes your day better, give us a ⭐ on GitHub — it helps more people find her! · Support the project: https://www.mekahime.com/donate

What you need

  • Windows 10 or 11 and an NVIDIA graphics card (RTX 20-series or newer, 8 GB of video memory or more; her camera eyes need 16 GB), with a recent driver
  • Python 3.11 (tick Add python.exe to PATH when you install it) and Git
  • About 45 GB of free disk. Setting her up downloads about 15–20 GB and takes 30–60 minutes
  • An OpenRouter key for her language model (recommended: a few dollars a month), or Ollama with a model of 27B or more and a graphics card big enough for it (see Which language model?)

Which language model?

Her ears, voice, memory and eyes always run on your PC. Her language model, the part that thinks and writes her replies, runs one of two ways:

  • Semi-Local (recommended): through OpenRouter on your own key. In almost all cases this is the better choice: she uses the models she was tested with, answers fast, and it only costs a few dollars a month (about $1.50 if you talk 30 turns a day, about $5 at 100 turns a day).
  • Fully Local: on your PC with Ollama. Use a model of 27B parameters or more; 70B or more gives the full, reliable experience. Models smaller than 27B may be really bad: she loses her character, forgets what you told her and breaks her reply format. A local model is also slower: all her thinking takes turns on it, so after you interrupt her, or while she saves a memory or reflects, a reply can take 5–50 s.

A local model needs its own video memory on top of the ~6 GB her ears, memory and voice use (~10 GB with her eyes): about 19 GB for a 27B model such as gemma3:27b, 24 GB for a 32B one such as qwen3:32b, and 50 GB for a 70B one such as qwen2.5:72b. So one 32 GB card (RTX 5090) holds a 27B model next to all of her (a 32B one only with her eyes off); a 24 GB card does not. A 70B model fits next to her only on a 72–96 GB workstation card. Otherwise run Ollama on a second PC (the Setup page takes its address), or stay Semi-Local. Whichever model you run, pick one that supports Chinese, since her prompts are written in it (llama3.3:70b, for one, does not). How to switch: Optional add-ons.

Set her up

Open PowerShell (a normal window, not as administrator) and run these lines one at a time. They put her in C:\OpenAmika, a short folder that OneDrive does not sync:

cd C:\
git clone https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika.git
cd OpenAmika
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\setup_windows.ps1   # her brain, ears, memory and eyes
envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe scripts\setup_tts.py                   # her voice, her Live2D model, the paper doll: type yes
.\Start_OpenAmika.bat                                                # start her

Her voice, her Live2D model and the paper doll are free under MekaHime's personal-use license (see Licenses): the setup_tts.py line shows it first and downloads her files only after you type yes.

Both setup commands end with a summary, one line per part: OK when it is done, !! with the fix when it is not, and -- for information only (for example: no OpenRouter key yet, your first visit asks for it). Running a command again resumes and skips everything that is finished. When the setup_tts.py summary shows OK voice MekaHime_Amika and OK Live2D model Amika, she has her voice and her body; OK paper doll Host is the stand-in for her helpers (Her helpers).

Talk to her

Double-click Start_OpenAmika.bat in the OpenAmika folder (in PowerShell: .\Start_OpenAmika.bat). One console starts all of her, and your browser opens http://localhost:53000 when she is ready: about a minute, a few more the very first time. On your first visit she introduces herself and asks your name, your city and, if brain\.env has none yet, your OpenRouter key. Then press the power button and talk, or type. Click the page once so the browser lets her speak.

The light at the top right of every page is her health: green means everything works; click it to see what is not. Double-click Stop_OpenAmika.bat (or press Ctrl+C in her console) to stop her. To check everything without starting anything, run envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe launch.py --check: it ends with result: ready, or names what to fix.

To update her: stop her, run git stash, git pull and git stash pop in the OpenAmika folder (this keeps your name, your city and your edits), then run the two setup commands again (they fetch only what changed).

If something goes wrong

what you see what to do
Python 3.11 was not found Install Python 3.11 (tick "Add python.exe to PATH"), open a new PowerShell window and run the setup again.
!! voice MekaHime_Amika not downloaded: her license was not accepted Run envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe scripts\setup_tts.py again and type yes.
!! voice MekaHime_Amika Hugging Face refused the download (HTTP 401) Her files are not public yet, or your HF_TOKEN is wrong. Set a read token from huggingface.co/settings/tokens in the same window ($env:HF_TOKEN = "hf_...") and run the command again.
download failed after 4 tries or Check the internet connection Run the same command again: it continues where it stopped. If huggingface.co cannot be reached from your network, set $env:HF_ENDPOINT to a Hugging Face mirror first; every file is still checked.
does not see the GPU (CUDA) Update your NVIDIA driver and run the setup again. Without an NVIDIA card: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\setup_windows.ps1 --cpu.
The filename or extension is too long The folder's path is too long for Windows: move OpenAmika to a short folder such as C:\OpenAmika and run the setup there.
settings.json not found Run powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\setup_windows.ps1 first.
No Live2D model yet on the stage, or !! Live2D model / !! her voice in launch.py --check Run envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe scripts\setup_tts.py.
no OpenRouter key yet (launch.py --check, the setup summary) Paste your key in the first-run wizard, or after OPENROUTER_API_KEY= in brain\.env.
!! TTS (voice) port 8002 answers but has no voice MekaHime_Amika Another voice server uses her port (OpenSakura's uses 8002 too). Stop it, or give her another port: change 8002 in tts_url and in services.tts (--port, health) in settings.json.
She answers in text but you hear nothing Give her voice about 20 seconds after a start, then click the page once. The health light must show TTS green.
Her voice stutters or is very slow Close other programs that use the graphics card, or turn her eyes off: "vision": {"enabled": false} in settings.json.
On Ollama she is out of character, forgets things, or her replies come out broken The model is too small. Use one of 27B or more (70B or more for the full experience), or go back to OpenRouter: Setup → Brain → OpenRouter → "Switch back to the OpenRouter preset".
On Ollama she answers very slowly If ollama ps shows a CPU/GPU split instead of 100% GPU, the model does not fit in your video memory next to her. With 100% GPU, slow replies after you interrupt her, or while she saves a memory or reflects, are normal for a local model. See Which language model?.
A helper's card on the Tools page is red, or she says she cannot reach Hermes or nanoMuse Run envs\brain\Scripts\python.exe launch.py --check and look at its agent and hermes key lines; every message and its fix is in docs/TOOLS.md.

Every part writes a log in logs\. For anything else, ask on Discord or open an issue. Using an AI coding agent? Point it at README_IF_YOU_ARE_AI_AGENT.md.

Optional add-ons

  • Fully Local: install Ollama, run ollama pull gemma3:27b (17 GB; or another model of 27B or more, see Which language model?), then on the Setup page choose Brain → Ollama → Detect models → Use this model. No key needed. For Ollama on another PC, type its address there before Detect models.
  • Her helpers: Hermes Agent or nanoMuse run errands for her, with the paper doll beside her on stage (below). Any other MCP server works too, on the Tools page (docs/TOOLS.md).
  • Smart home: Zigbee plugs she can switch (IoT/README.md). It stays off until you read and accept the IoT safety statement (docs/IOT_DISCLAIMER.md) on the Tools page. She runs on language models and can make mistakes: never connect heaters, locks, valves or anything that could cause harm.
  • Text her on Discord or Telegram (docs/MESSENGERS.md).
  • Your phone: Tailscale_Serve_OpenAmika.bat makes her reachable on your own devices over Tailscale.

Her helpers: Hermes and nanoMuse

She can hand errands to a helper program on your PC, Hermes Agent or nanoMuse: it searches the web, uses a browser and works with files. She decides whether to help, gives the helper the task after she has answered you, relays its questions, and tells you the result in her own words. While a helper is switched on, MekaHime's paper doll stands at the bottom right of her stage and plays the helper's side. Each helper runs its own model on OpenRouter, and the key she uses works for it.

Hermes Agent: install it from a PowerShell window. This form of its installer asks no questions; the lines after it do the setup OpenAmika needs:

& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1))) -NonInteractive

Then, in a new PowerShell window:

hermes model                                    # choose OpenRouter, paste your key, then "Enter custom model name": z-ai/glm-5
$key = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')          # a random key for its API server
hermes config set API_SERVER_ENABLED true
hermes config set API_SERVER_KEY $key
hermes gateway stop                             # a Hermes already running reads the key only when it starts again

nanoMuse: clone it into the Nanomuse folder, give it a config.toml and put your key in its own vault; the commands and the file are in docs/TOOLS.md.

Connect them. In the OpenAmika folder, run Copy-Item config\tools.example.json config\tools.json (only if there is no config\tools.json yet) and notepad config\tools.json. Set "enabled": true at the top and in the helper's entry. For nanoMuse, "NANOMUSE_LANGUAGE" is the language it answers in ("en"; or "ja", "zh-CN"). For Hermes, copy its key with this line and paste it (Ctrl+V) as "HERMES_API_KEY":

(Select-String -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\hermes\.env" -Pattern '^API_SERVER_KEY=(.+)').Matches[0].Groups[1].Value | Set-Clipboard

Save and start her (.\Start_OpenAmika.bat): she starts her helpers herself. On the Tools page the helper's card turns green (agent online).

Meet the paper doll. Open the Use page: the doll slides onto her stage. Ask her, for example, "Can you have Hermes check tomorrow's weather?". She answers, types the task in her speech bubble, and the doll takes over: it thinks while the helper works, speaks the helper's steps in its own bubble, looks surprised when the helper has a question or needs your OK (say yes or no, or click Approve on the Use page), and is happy when the result comes, which she then tells you. The doll comes with setup_tts.py (OK paper doll Host in its summary).

Every step in detail, and what each message means: docs/TOOLS.md.

Licenses

  • OpenAmika's code is MIT (LICENSE). Third-party parts keep their own licenses (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md); the Live2D Cubism Core in ui/vendor/ is not MIT.
  • Amika herself is not MIT. Her character, art, voice, Live2D model and their weights, and the paper doll that stands in for her helpers (MekaHime/MekaHime_Amika), belong to MekaHime Inc. and are free under a personal-use license: personal use only, 18+, no redistribution or re-hosting, and no training other models on them. Two creator rules: earn on social media (videos, streams, ads, memberships, sponsorships) with no limit, crediting MekaHime.AI visibly; and fan merch up to US$1,000 in total, as an individual, made from fan art you recreated yourself (never an original image MekaHime published on its website or social media), with "MekaHime.AI" on the visible side and a small "Fan Art" label. Any other commercial use needs a license from MekaHime (hi@mekahime.com). The LICENSE on Hugging Face governs.
  • Hermes Agent (MIT) and nanoMuse (GPL-3.0-or-later) are separate programs you install yourself; OpenAmika only talks to them.
  • Built on SenseVoice, GPT-SoVITS, bge-m3, Qwen3-VL, pixi-live2d-display with the Live2D Cubism SDK, OpenRouter, Ollama and the Model Context Protocol. Thank you.

Support

Questions and bugs: GitHub issues, hi@mekahime.com, or Discord. Support the project: https://www.mekahime.com/donate

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open-source Live2D AI companion with real-time voice and long-term memory capabilities.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: OpenAmika provides a locally hosted AI companion featuring a fully animated Live2D avatar. It engages in real-time voice and text conversations while maintaining long-term memory of user interactions. The system can connect to remote services like OpenRouter or run completely offline using Ollama. It integrates speech recognition and text-to-speech to create a deeply immersive and interactive experience.
keyFeatures: Live2D Avatar: Features a fully animated character that reacts to conversations naturally.
Real-time Voice: Integrates low-latency speech recognition and text-to-speech engines.
Long-term Memory: Retains contextual information across multiple sessions for personalized interactions.
Local Execution: Supports running language models locally via Ollama for privacy.
API Flexibility: Connects easily to robust cloud models via OpenRouter when preferred.
